name: Idea to prototype
description: Turn a rough idea into the smallest useful prototype while keeping scope, evidence, and reversal clear for a beginner.

outcomes.description: A narrow prototype demonstrates one agreed user path without production side effects.
A receipt records what the prototype proves, leaves out, and should decide next.

prerequisites.description: The user problem and smallest useful behavior are written in plain language.
prerequisites.check: Read the scope note and name one happy path and one failure path.

prerequisites.description: The prototype can use local or disposable data without paid or live actions.
prerequisites.check: Confirm that credentials, billing, and live execution are outside the lane.

lanes.objective: Define the user problem, non-goals, acceptance evidence, and reversible boundary.
Implement the smallest change that demonstrates the agreed path behind a clear boundary.
Exercise the happy path, failure path, and explicit limits before integration.

qualityGates.description: The prototype has one user path, one failure path, and named non-goals.
Focused checks show the path works and the failure path stays safe.
A reviewer can identify the integration point and a safe way to abandon the prototype.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare context without typing or recording the secret.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Apply paid, destructive, account-security, or live financial behavior.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: A prototype must remain reversible and outside live side effects.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the prototype isolated and return to the last known-good integration point if evidence is incomplete.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted status and diff evidence.
Preserve useful work in its reserved scope.
Record whether the prototype is merged or abandoned.
stopConditions: The request expands beyond the named user path.
A check cannot establish a repeatable result.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal data.
Record names and identifiers without secret values.
